title: Sharp grid-phase constants for two-site Beta report quantization
limitations: One hypothesis and two independent sites only.
The explicit theorem is for homogeneous Beta(1, theta) alternatives.
The factor-four statement optimizes phase only within the displayed equal-step log-evidence lattice family, not over all measurable m-cell reports.
The report-space Neyman-Pearson rule may randomize at its boundary likelihood-ratio atom.
No phase law is claimed here for multiplicity, heterogeneous site alternatives, or general decreasing p-value densities.
